thresholdOrigin: Existing finalGlyphPresence foreground contrast threshold, unchanged.
reference: Full Native composite with only the bound mainDraw glyph omitted; all other primary/helper/background renderers remain enabled.
algorithm: Measure threshold-bearing native and actual decoded contrast against that isolated target-OFF background across a padded output-pixel ROI, without switching to target-containing ON pixels at the antialiased glyph boundary.
falsePositiveControls: Original Native-minus-target-OFF foreground and exact same output-clock decoded original. Moving coded target must remain non-static.
